findings.title: Discount rate is a float instead of an int
findings.body: The new `spring_price_cents` function passes `rate = 0.2` to `apply_discount`, which expects `percent` as an `int`. Passing a float here will cause a type error or incorrect rounding. Pass an integer rate (e.g., 20) instead.

summary.problem: The spring sale price calculation uses a float discount rate where an integer is expected, risking a type error or incorrect rounding.
summary.done_well: The new function clearly documents its purpose and reuses the existing `list_price_cents` helper.
